transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’ve been having these evenings where I’ll get a family-size takeout order, then pick up chips or bakery stuff too, and eat most of it by myself. It’s like I don’t really register how much I’ve eaten until it’s already gone.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit to try to undo them?
No, I haven’t made myself vomit after.
During these eating episodes, do you feel unable to stop eating or control how much you eat?
Yes. Once I start, it feels like a switch flips. I can be telling myself, “Taylor, put it away,” but I keep opening containers and eating anyway, like I’m not really in charge of my hands.
After these eating episodes, do you do anything else to try to make up for the calories, like fasting, exercising a lot, or taking laxatives?
I’m not really sure what counts, exactly. I don’t think I do anything specific afterward—I mostly just feel bad about it.
During these eating episodes, do you feel like you can’t stop or control how much you’re eating?
Yes. It’s like a switch flips once I start. I’m thinking, “Taylor, put it away,” but I keep opening more containers and eating. It feels like I’m not really in charge of my hands.
When this happens, do you eat an unusually large amount of food for the situation?
Yes. I’ll buy a family-size takeout meal, then pick up chips or something from the bakery too, and eat most of it myself in one evening. Before I know it, there’s hardly anything left.
After you overeat like that, do you ever fast afterward to make up for it?
I don’t think so. I might eat a little less the next day because I feel guilty, but I don’t deliberately fast.
After these eating episodes, do you ever exercise a lot specifically to burn off what you ate?
I’m not sure what you mean by exercising a lot. I don’t really think of it as something I do specifically because of an episode.
After one of these eating episodes, do you ever exercise for a long time specifically to make up for what you ate?
No, I don’t exercise for a long time to make up for it. I don’t really connect exercise to those episodes.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress?

Yes. I feel really ashamed and get stuck thinking about it afterward. I’ve stopped inviting people over, and sometimes I skip my evening yoga or even gardening chores because I just don’t want to deal with anything.
How often do these binge-eating episodes happen?
Looking back at my journal, there’s barely been a week in the last several months when it hasn’t happened at least once. Most weeks, it happens several times.
